description: C99 register model for unit testing embedded drivers: MMIO, RW, RO, W1C, read-clear, and bounded access traces without heap allocation.
rules: Use mxs_reganvil.h and the documented mxs_reganvil_* API. The CMake target is mxs::reganvil.
Use caller-owned descriptor, state, context, and optional trace storage with the documented lifetimes and non-overlap requirements.
Check status codes. Initialization and failed operations preserve outputs as documented.
A driver needs replaceable register accessors; RegAnvil does not intercept arbitrary volatile pointers or emulate a CPU.
Use peek for assertions without read-clear side effects. W1C acknowledgements must preserve unrelated pending flags.
Operations on one instance are single-threaded and non-reentrant. Validate descriptors against the hardware datasheet.
